title: Leaking tap in ground floor kitchen
description: Tenant reports persistent drip from kitchen cold tap. Water pooling on worktop. Started yesterday morning.

title: Emergency - no heating in nursery wing
description: Complete heating failure in nursery wing affecting 40+ children. Radiators stone cold, boiler showing E119 fault code.

title: Flickering lights in reception
description: Multiple fluorescent tubes flickering in main reception area. Creating headaches for front desk staff.

title: Fire door not closing on 3rd floor
description: Fire door near stairwell B on 3rd floor not closing properly. Door closer mechanism appears broken. Significant fire safety concern.

title: Blocked drain in car park
description: Surface water drain in underground car park backing up. Water pooling near spaces 14-18. Slip hazard.

title: Roof leak above flat 12
description: Water ingress through ceiling in flat 12 bedroom during heavy rain. Brown stain spreading on ceiling.

title: Lift stuck between floors
description: Passenger lift stuck between ground and 1st floor. No passengers trapped currently but lift out of service.

title: Pest control - mice in bin store
description: Mice droppings found in communal bin store. Multiple tenants have reported sightings over the past week.

title: Broken window latch flat 7
description: Window latch in flat 7 living room broken. Window cannot be secured shut. Ground floor - security concern.

title: Annual PAT testing - all units
description: Scheduled portable appliance testing across all 24 units. Landlord obligation under Electrical Safety Standards.
